question: In the Constitution of India, Emergency provisions are given in Articles:
solution:
The correct answer is __**352 to 360**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Articles 352 to 360 of the Indian Constitution deal with Emergency provisions.
 
• Article 352 pertains to the proclamation of Emergency (National Emergency) due to war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.
 
• Article 356 deals with the imposition of President's Rule in states due to the failure of the constitutional machinery.
 
• Article 360 provides for a Financial Emergency due to a threat to the financial stability or credit of India.
 
• These provisions enable the central government to assume greater control during exceptional situations to ensure national security and governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 352:** Allows the President to declare a National Emergency if the security of India or any part of it is threatened.
 
• **Article 356:** Empowers the President to assume control of a state if its government cannot function according to constitutional provisions.
 
• **Article 360:** Grants the President the authority to declare a Financial Emergency if the financial stability of India is in jeopardy.
 
• **Types of Emergencies:** National Emergency, State Emergency (President's Rule), and Financial Emergency.
 
• **Impact:** During an emergency, fundamental rights may be suspended, and the central government gains significant authority over states.
